probe_finding: Definition (deep-scroll catalog, 2026-10-15): WTPRR (Weighted Targets Per Route Run) is @YardsPerGretch's metric, charted weekly by @StephenKrupka alongside TPRR and WOPR: it takes TPRR (targets per route run, C-281's usage axis) and layers air yards in, so a target earned deep counts for more than a target earned at the line. Role in-engine: the depth-weighted form of receiver target-earning — it separates manufactured short volume from earned downfield volume, the same distinction the tranche-1 WR Target Outlook record (C-280 enrichment, 'PPR SCAM' zone) draws geometrically. Stamped provenance: the metric appears across Krupka's 13-month catalog as a standing weekly series for WRs and TEs.
